run_hf_to_s3_upload: run the hf_to_s3 script to download a Hugging Face repo and upload files to an S3 bucket
run_hf_to_s3_with_revision: run the hf_to_s3 script with a specific revision hash to upload a tagged Hugging Face repo to S3
run_hf_to_s3_with_suffix: run the hf_to_s3 script with a custom suffix to append to the S3 upload path
run_hf_to_s3_custom_bucket: run the hf_to_s3 script to upload Hugging Face data to a custom S3 bucket name
run_hf_to_s3_manifest: run the hf_to_s3 script to generate a manifest.json listing downloaded files before S3 upload
